title: Power of Three Check
description: Given a signed 32-bit integer `n`, return `true` if `n` is a power of three (meaning there exists an integer `k >= 0` such that `n == 3^k`), and `false` otherwise.
hints: Because 3 is prime, a positive 32-bit integer is a power of 3 if and only if it divides the largest power of 3 that fits in a signed 32-bit integer.
The largest power of 3 within `2^31 - 1` is `3^19 = 1162261467`, so check `n > 0 && 1162261467 % n == 0` in O(1) time.

examples.explanation: 0 is not a power of three.
Negative integers like -9 can never equal 3^k for any integer k.
